snippet.title: PlayStation - Golden Nugget (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Immerse yourself in the GOLDEN NUGGET and you'll enjoy Las Vegas-style casino gaming the way it's meant to be played - in a four-star casino paradise with 16 games of chance to challenge and thrill you.

Explore the lavish and elegant surroundings of the legendary GOLDEN NUGGET. Play Blackjack and Poker. Try your hand at Roulette and Craps.

This is virtual nonstop casino action and entertainment with all the authenticity and splendor of the real thing.
